name: Finite Admissibility Budget Law
purpose: Define finite admissibility capacity as a governing constraint on continuation propagation.

candidate_law_statement.informal: A continuation process can propagate only while its admissibility cost remains within the available local or regional admissibility budget.

formal.continuation_cost_candidate: Cost_A(R_α) := F(transport_flux, admissibility_margin_use, projection_cost, reinforcement_load, reconstruction_loss)
formal.budget_condition: Continue(R_α) is admissible only if Cost_A(R_α) ≤ B_A(α) under declared local tolerance.
formal.depletion_condition: B_A(α,n+1) may decrease when continuation consumes admissibility capacity through transport, projection, or reinforcement load.
formal.recovery_condition: B_A(α,n+1) may recover when local reconciliation stabilizes, flux decreases, or boundary pressure relaxes.
formal.saturation_condition: Saturate(α) occurs when continuation demand exceeds available admissibility budget and triggers pruning, delay, redirection, collapse, or horizon formation.
